title: שיר ידידות – ר' דוד בוזגלו
overview: Rabbi David Buzaglo was the greatest Hebrew liturgical poet of the twentieth century. Born in Morocco in 1903, his literary output had a major impact on a community of hundreds of thousands of people. From his prolific period in the Diaspora to the years he spent in a ruptured Israel, Buzaglo's poetry initiated an abrupt shift in Sephardic liturgical writing, but it also served as a vital link between the modern era and a tradition that dates back to Spanish Jewry's Golden Age. But Buzaglo was more than just a great poet. The actions he took at seminal moments in history had a critical impact in shaping the identity of Maghreb Jews. This film is an intimate look at Buzaglo's life and career, from its roots in the rich tradition of Hebrew poetry in Morocco through the liturgical revolution in Israel.

title: The Room
overview: In The Room, Franco-Egyptian visual artist Youssef Nabil delivers a poetic, meditative short film that plays like a vintage piece of Golden Age Egyptian celluloid. Melding moving image with his signature hand-colored, highly theatrical aesthetic, Nabil crafts a comforting fable about mortality and transition.  The film follows Nabil as a soul contemplating the end of his earthly existence. He is met at the threshold by performance art icon Marina Abramović, who embodies a serene, angelic guide. Rather than leading him into darkness, Abramović awakens him from the "dream" of life and ushers him through a symbolic doorway into a radiant, hyper-saturated paradise. Materializing as a traditional Farah (an Arabic wedding celebration meaning "Joy"), this afterlife becomes a festive, music-filled homecoming—framing the end of life not as a tragedy, but as a beautiful transition into eternal celebration.

title: Izaihō
overview: Kudaka Island in Nanjo City, Okinawa Prefecture, has long been known as an island of the gods. Around thirty religious rites are woven into the life of the island each year, and they are still solemnly preserved and passed down by the islanders today. The greatest of these rituals is the “Izaihō,” held once every twelve years in the Year of the Horse.  “Izaihō” is a sacred rite in which women between the ages of 30 and 41, born and raised on the island, become priestesses or divine women. Centered around a four-day main ceremony, the ritual unfolds over the course of more than a month. The women of the island, led by the noro priestesses, formed a religious order that protected the men and the daily life of the community.  This is a documentary record of the 1966 “Izaihō.”

A gift from an American family funds construction of the city’s first modern health clinic, inspiring other donors to send medical supplies. Against great odds, the clinic has thrived for 13 years. Award-winning writer-director Ann Hedreen traces the unlikely connection between the people of this asentamiento humano (human settlement), and her great-uncle, a Swedish-American pioneer of the Peruvian fishing industry. The film introduces a network of teachers, volunteers, medical professionals–and one very determined priest–who help these refugees carve a new life from an abandoned gravel pit in one of the world’s most sprawling megacities. With an estimated one-sixth of the world’s population now living in settlements like Manchay, Zona Intangible portrays the challenges facing one such community, and the complex ties between their future and a benefactor they never met.

title: BODY/LAND
overview: An experimental documentary featuring care-led practices of audiovisual archive remix, interviews and collaborative performances. The film features the home movies of Paul Berry, who was an Oscar-nominated animator, whose personal Super 8 collection is a sadly rare example of queer domestic life in film archive collections. Supported by research at the North West Film Archive, these moments of queer joy, chosen family, rural trips, and celebrations are reimagined alongside other regional film collections to a newly composed original score.  Five portraits of specially featured artists discuss narratives that reflect how queer and trans creatives understand themselves, their histories, and their representation in relation to environment and landscape. These interventions weave through each artist’s practice in photography, spoken word, performance, sculpture and music, moving towards an expansive language of BODY(s) and LAND(s).

Together, as they explore Delhi’s historical monuments or meet children from the basti Nizamuddin playing with Khusrau’s Hindvi poetry, Ankit renders some of Khusrau’s historical works in a typical dastan goi style. This journey comes to an interesting twist when Ankit’s dastan goi persona ‘detaches’ from him and turns into a ‘real’ historical character! title: Liar Malaysia
overview: It tells the story of Lara Sulaiman, a wise and dedicated teacher. After divorcing her husband, Lara tries to 'move on' and goes on a date with a surgeon who has recently lost his wife, Aiman Yusuf. They feel very comfortable with each other's presence. However, after meeting, the two of them have different stories about their dating experience. Lara accuses Aiman of raping her, while Aiman insists that he helped an unwell Lara get home safely. Who is telling the truth? 'Liar' witnesses the deception that could destroy the lives of Lara and Aiman, as well as their friends and families when secrets and lies are exposed.

title: Saat Hilang Cintamu
overview: Razil, a devoted husband who loves his wife Salina and is her main supporter. However, their relationship begins to crack when Salina is influenced by her friends' words that mock and belittle her husband. Salina decides to meet with a counseling expert for a counseling session. However, everything changes when the counseling expert seduces Salina and they begin to cross the line. What will happen?

title: Bukan Puteri Lindungan Bulan
overview: # The Struggles of Larasati Aisya  The film depicts the hardships and trials of a girl named Larasati Aisya (Janna Nick). Also known as Lara or Puteri, she is constantly tested with various challenges due to hatred and misfortune. Her father's death forces her to temporarily abandon her studies. Managing the business left behind by her late father becomes her responsibility. Her brother Lukman's (Shah Iskandar) marriage to Sabrina (Afifah Nasir) brings problems for Lara. She does not get along with Sabrina. The situation becomes more tense when Sabrina, who also works in Lara's business company, takes the initiative to bring her sister-in-law into the company. Lara's trials become even more difficult with the passing of another beloved person.

title: Masjid Nak Roboh
overview: Pak Masdar and Pak Bagak are two village leaders. Because the mosque in their village is very dilapidated, they plan to build a new mosque.

title: Jodoh Duda I
overview: It tells the story of Dahlia and Akmal, a young couple whose marriage does not last long. They are blessed with a son named Aiman. Although divorced, they remain close friends for the sake of Aiman.

title: [REDACTED]
overview: In the year [REDACTED] where everyone, including police dispatchers, has been replaced by AI, 17 year old [REDACTED] is suddenly kidnapped from his home in [REDACTED], leading him to question if anyone will notice his disappearance.
tagline: DO YOU KNOW WHERE YOUR CHILDREN ARE?

title: Isle Navigator: The Buried Baby
overview: The quake stole a mother's memory, but her child never forgot. Buried deep underground, how will he find a way to restore the memories she has lost? A segment of the Taiwanese animated anthology Isle Navigator, the film had its world premiere as a standalone short at the 30th Fantasia International Film Festival, where it was selected for the Satoshi Kon Award competition.

title: Memintas Al-Qadar
overview: Fikri and Faisal, who were friends while living in a children's home, were forced to part ways when Faisal was adopted and moved abroad. After growing up and living their own lives, they are destined to reunite, but their friendship is tested when Faisal is no longer the person Fikri once knew.

title: Sinopsis Polis Evo 3
overview: Inspector Khai and Inspector Sani return with a new mission and this time their team is accompanied by Inspector Dani, Inspector Julie and Inspector Dell who have different expertise. An explosion in Penang that has killed hundreds of victims including a police officer is now under investigation by Inspectors Sani and Khai. The situation becomes more complicated when the next target is Inspector Khai. The friendship between Inspector Khai and Inspector Sani is tested when they realize that the suspect they are hunting has a connection to Inspector Khai's past.

title: Somero
overview: The Four Seasons - part one: Two strangers are brought together during a lock-down, in the wake of a world changing natural event.
tagline: Overcome the fear

title: Telah Aku Halalkan
overview: The story of Mak Munah, a single mother who has four children. All her children have grown up but they all still expect their mother to serve them for various reasons. Mak Munah feels sad about what is happening in her life and is hurt by what her children have done to her. Eventually, she decides to bequeath all her wealth to Baitulmal after her death. But will there still be a chance for them to seek forgiveness from their beloved mother?

title: The Blessing
overview: New short movie by Caroline Poggi and Jonathan Vinel

title: Quran Pondok Buruk
overview: The story of three disobedient siblings obsessed with seeking forgiveness from their mother who has passed away. Usop, who once sinned, now tries to become a better person but is tested by discord as his family commits sins similar to his past. This heavy trial nearly breaks Usop, causing him to rage and burn the shabby hut where he prays out of anger at God. This incident almost costs the life of his wife, Som, and makes Usop realize that he must continue to strive to reunite his family and help his children return to the right path.

title: Munawar Faruqui: Dhandho
overview: In this special, Munawar Faruqui shares his side of the story about being jailed.
tagline: Every headlines has two sides, this one is his.

title: For We Are Many 2
overview: A feature-length Lovecraftian horror anthology.

title: Kerasnya Takdir
overview: Intan Najiha, more affectionately known as Jiha (Amyra Rosli), is raised modestly while Syed Munir (Redza Rosli) is pampered with wealth. After losing her parents, Jiha moves to Kuala Lumpur to be independent and starts a small candle business called 'Jiha's Scent' at a shopping mall. In contrast, Munir's life has been filled with luxury from birth and he is expected to continue his family's legacy by his mother Syarifah Aminah (Kartina Aziz). His mother wants to manage everything about Munir, including arranging his marriage to his fiancée, Emilia (Mia Nasir). When an incident brings Munir and Jiha together and romantic feelings begin to develop, Munir chooses to make Jiha his wife despite their marriage not being blessed by his family. However, married life is not as expected. Munir and Jiha's life becomes complicated after Munir is involved in an accident. Jiha is also burdened with accusations that have made her mental state unstable after losing Munir and their child.

title: Somewhere in a Free Country
original_title: Quelque part dans un pays libre
overview: A new short movie by Antonin Peretjatko

title: Cikgu Terpaling A
overview: Cikgu Wira is a teacher at Sri Gemilang school in a village. He is a brilliant teacher who has frequently been honored with various awards and prestigious titles at the school. That is, until a new teacher named Cikgu Johan joins the school. Now, Cikgu Wira has a new rival! Different from previous years, the two of them are actively competing to showcase their best performance to win a special award. Not only that, they are also competing to win the attention and love of Cikgu Rose. However, they remain responsible and never neglect student discipline issues and problems. In this intense competition between Cikgu Wira and Johan, various funny stories and incidents occur that stir up the entire Gemilang village!

title: Playboy: Women of Color
overview: They're exciting, exotic and absolutely alluring they're Playboy's Women of Color. Hosted by 1990 Playmate of the Year Renee Tenison (the first African American woman to capture the coveted title), this special showcases with pride the ethnic, beauty that makes these women some of the most vibrant and radiant in the world. Join Renee as she introduces her Playmate girl- friends, each having ancestral spirit and a sense of style and soul that's all her own. You'll fly high with gorgeous flight attendant Lorraine Olivia, and luxuriate in a waterfall oasis with Jamaican born lovely Venice Kong. Then, it's time for spontaneous fun with West Indian, Cherokee and Irish stunner Stephanie Adams, and relaxing moments from Reneé. Plus, indulge in a variety of erotic fantasies for you and your lover to share. Color your world with Playboy Women of Color and enjoy the sensual celebration.

title: Refuge
overview: At the "Veeweyde" shelter, bonds between humans and animals are broken and formed every day. In this arena, the shelter's team members must deal with the humans they meet, determine the reasons for abandonments, and analyze the desire for adoption in order to provide the best possible future for the animals they take in. In the end, isn't their job to analyze our relationship with our pets? And wouldn't these relationships be a reflection of the way we connect with others?

title: Hari-hari Terakhir Seorang Pendosa
overview: The life of a resilient woman turns upside down with the arrival of her biological mother, who suffers from mental illness and was once a prostitute. However, the harsh reality awakens her to how great her mother's sacrifice truly was. Ramona grew up with Nayan, who counts down her final days feeling guilty for not being honest with Ramona all this time. The guilt of a sinner leads to the search for Che Dah.

title: Mualaf Ekspres
overview: Sean Lee, a young Chinese man, attempts to fast throughout Ramadan this time. In reality, he is doing all this to prove to his girlfriend Sweet's family that he is willing to do anything to demonstrate his sincerity towards her. This includes being willing to fast in order to maintain his relationship with Sweet. Meanwhile, Mak Liza, Sweet's mother, plans to matchmake her daughter with a man named Ropie who is also wealthy in their village. Mak Liza believes that Sweet will be happier marrying a perfect rich man. To achieve her goal of matchmaking Sweet with Ropie, Mak Liza devises various schemes together with Ropie to sabotage Sean Lee's fasting attempt. But will their plans succeed? And how does Sean Lee overcome these attempts?

title: A Day in the Life of a Suffragette
overview: Women are as good as men. They are even better than men. Thus a crowd of common women are making speeches, and drunk with their own words and getting up to battle pitch, they start forth into the street armed with banners rapidly made and screaming revolutionary songs. They march against a police patrol, who are endeavoring to bar the way. The female onslaught is so powerful that the poor policemen fall sprawling on the ground, and as the female wave sweeps over their prostrate bodies they have reason to regret their rash attempt. Encouraged by their first success; our suffragettes go on their way, their number getting bigger at every street turn, until things take an alarming aspect: the militia is called out, and after a comic struggle between women and soldiers, the whole female force to marched into custody and locked up for the night. The next morning the subdued women are seen coming out of jail and meekly following their husbands on their way back to their domestic duties.

title: Dirty Laundry
overview: Alba, a young woman, has reached the bottom of despair. Her aunt tries to help her, risking to be dragged in her niece's ravine.

title: Raya Tahun Depan
overview: After her house is broken into by a thief, a cute little girl who is often pampered by her mother faints and is transported through 'time travel' to the future year to celebrate lavishly with her new family.

title: Heroes: The Story of the Fifa Women's World Cup
original_title: Heroes: The Story of the Fifa Women's World Cup
overview: A history of the Women's World Cup told through the eyes of some of the best players to have graced the competition.

title: The Reformation of the Suffragettes
overview: Because their husbands enjoy the gentle art of fishing, the women of the village vow vengeance and ostracize all their husbands. After many ludicrous experiences attempting to do without the tyrant men, they find it impossible and rejoice in the return of their erstwhile hated oppressors.

title: Mendarat Di Syurga
overview: Khalif and Dyan are two strangers who board flight JK566 of Eriqa Airways, scheduled to fly to Genovia. However, everything changes when the plane is destined to crash. Since then, the lives of their family members and friends change suddenly. Rayhan, Khalif's mother, is not satisfied with her son's career as a flight attendant. Julia is burdened with guilt because she asked Khalif to cover her shift that night. Elyas, meanwhile, has been unfaithful to his wife, Dyan. From months to years, will they be able to rise again and move past their regrets?

title: Senaskah Braille
overview: Seeing his mother who can no longer read the Quran because she has gone blind due to an accident has caused Naufal to resolve to collect money to gift a braille Quran to his mother before Ramadan arrives. At the same time, Naufal desperately wishes to meet his father whom he has never encountered. Will Naufal succeed in achieving what he desires?

title: Art Escape -هروب فنى
overview: Seeking refuge from the boredom and noise of  outside world, a person enters a museum -only to discover an  unexpected adventure within.
tagline: where art comes  to life

title: France vs Morocco Live
overview: France vs Morocco Live
tagline: Arabic

title: Estlink1
overview: This synopsis, just after you opened it and it appeared before your eyes, was shot straight across the sea by a wire as thin as a human hair.  All information reaches us through wet tubes laying at the bottom of the ocean. During the period of two years, I visited specific landing sites of the Estlink1 optic fiber cable in Estonia and Finland. Here the cable comes ashore, at these points it delivers and transmits almost everything; from love letters to election results. These places are known to be critical sites and targets for sabotage. The film reflects on the vulnerability of our data transmission. In Estlink1 technology and nature are closely intertwined given their sensitive existence. How do we deal with invisible dangers and unseen infrastructures that quietly hold our world together?

title: Bluebeard
overview: Adaptation of the famous tale.
tagline: A Fairy Story

title: A Bet Too Far
overview: Michael, struggling with a gambling addiction, risks his marriage and career. When Hikmat tries to steal his wallet an unlikely bond forms, they confront their pasts, leading to redemption and a chance to change their lives forever.

title: The Hound
overview: After stealing a green jade amulet depicting a flying dog from an ancient tomb, the robbers are cursed by a strange flying creature that follows, haunts, and drives them mad. The two grave robbers become victims of their own obsession…

title: Tujuh Dua Belas
overview: The story follows Safia, a self-defense martial arts athlete who is forced to fight for her life to save her kidnapped nephew. Around 7:00 AM, Safia (Farali Khan) and her nephew Adam (Adam Darwisyh) are on their way to a hotel to meet her friend Desi (Chintya Chandranaya) and then to the airport for a holiday to Desi's hometown. While traveling to the hotel, Safia's car is stopped by a group of men who threaten her and rob her bag and mobile phone. Bentayan kidnaps Adam while Safia attempts to fight back but is forced to surrender to prevent Adam from being shot. Safia tries to follow them but unfortunately, when they reach an intersection, they become separated. Safia faces numerous challenges as she attempts to track them down.

title: A SWEET DAY
overview: When a young woman gets the chance to have a conjugal meeting with her imprisoned husband after a long time,  ​she decides to re-experience a romantic time in the apathetic and harsh atmosphere of the prison.

title: VISA
overview: Four young Egyptians start their careers in the marketing field until they meet a businessman who persuades them to invest in a new digital currency. Even though they work with him, he chooses to defraud them, take their money, and run away to America with it. They start to follow him in order to get their money back.

title: Sinopsis Special Force Anarchy
overview: # English Translation  Following the journey of Iman (Puteri Aishah), a young, enthusiastic police officer from a fictional country, Tenggara. Unexpectedly, an investigation into a planned bank robbery not only brings her face to face with a dangerous underground group, but also unveils a big secret capable of changing everything! As a brilliant and versatile police officer, Iman is recruited to join a special elite anti-corruption task force led by her own father, Commander Qabil (Hasnul Rahmat). Established specifically to solve the most dangerous criminal cases, Iman's participation has helped the team uncover a heist plan at Tenggara Bank by a vicious criminal gang known as Azazel. This terrorist group is led by a man named Umar (Dato' M. Nasir). In the midst of this conflict, Iman finds herself at an impasse when faced with a shocking revelation. Iman is now forced to make an impossible choice.

title: Reaper Road
overview: Two friends end up on a never-ending road that leads into the woods, trapping them in a hellish dimension.
tagline: No turning back

title: Abah Next Door
overview: ~will be updated

title: Madre adoptiva
overview: Two guilty mothers. One who acknowledges the truth and the other who denies it.

title: Sinopsis Duan Nago Bogho
overview: The story follows Duan, a traditional Kelantan Mak Yong artist and performer who possesses two distinct personalities. He is passionate about traditional art but is also quick to fight. His story begins after Duan gets into a fight with a Mak Yong audience member who disrupts his performance, leading his father to ask him to leave the village and find other work. His friend Awi, who lives in Kuala Lumpur, invites Duan to the capital city. Awi tells him that Kuala Lumpur offers greater opportunities in the arts field, including Mak Yong. Awi is an arts worker who seeks to bring Kelantan arts to a wider and more advanced level. Additionally, Duan's task is to help Nancy, the daughter of Jimmy Ang, a man of Chinese descent from Kelantan, which brings conflict into Duan's life.

title: 5A
overview: A photographer becomes the subject of his own obsession when he realises that someone has turned the lens on him.

title: Bedak Arang
overview: Lee is a blacksmith who greatly hopes his son will inherit the family's generations-old talent for iron forging. Unfortunately, his son is reluctant to accept his father's suggestion and offers various excuses. This situation causes Lee to decide to continue the business alone. Meanwhile, his wife, Xiu Ching, is a former renowned opera singer from the past. However, due to her age, no one seeks her out for performances anymore. Most of her time is spent at home as a housewife. Until one day Lee faces a criminal who blackmails and extorts money from him. Lee becomes increasingly stressed with his problems, and at the same time Xiu Ching is forgetting more and more things. The appearance of a young boy who shows a deep interest in iron forging brings light into Lee's life. He begins to see who he wants to pass his career on to. But will his dreams come true?

title: The Presence of the Absence
overview: Vicente, an 11-year-old boy and Guillermo, an 80-year-old man, meet every day at the same bus stop. Although they recognize each other, they never relate. An unexpected event confronts Vicente with himself, revealing one of the primordial conditions of human nature.

title: Bukan Lelaki Terhebat
overview: # Translation  Jaden (Adam Lee) is an orphan who works as a personal bodyguard for Datuk Samsul Azri. One day, Jaden is attacked by Datuk Samsul Azri after being accused of having a relationship with his mistress, Ariana (Anies Hann). Jaden is beaten severely until he suffers serious injuries and is thrown into a rubber plantation belonging to Pak Samad (Omar Abdullah). Since that incident, Jaden's life in the village has been taken care of by Pak Samad and Seri Dhia (Sweet Qismina), including his food and drinks. Jaden eventually falls in love with Seri Dhia. Seri Dhia's engagement to Dr. Iqram is called off when Puan Zalina, Dr. Iqram's mother, accuses Seri Dhia of having a romantic relationship with Jaden. Seri Dhia is upset with Dr. Iqram for accepting the accusation without question. After four months of knowing each other, Jaden and Seri Dhia confess their feelings for each other with open hearts. In the sweetness, there is always hidden bitterness.

title: Mirror Like
overview: Mirror Like tells the story of Aurelio, a psychologist and single father, who struggles to maintain his sanity as everything seems to mirror his own suffering. This unfolds against the backdrop of a momentous event: several months ago, the sun disappeared, darkness reigns, and society is plunged into utter confusion. Fernanda, his younger daughter, suffers from a rare illness that slowly takes its toll on him. With his wife missing, Aurelio becomes his children's sole support, but his strength has its limits, and they are nearing their end.

title: They Speak of Hope: The Church in El Salvador
original_title: They Speak of Hope: The Church in El Salvador
overview: They Speak of Hope: The Church in El Salvador is a 1986 documentary that examines the role of the Catholic Church during the Salvadoran Civil War. The film focuses on the efforts of religious figures and communities in El Salvador as they navigate the extreme violence and political instability of the era. It emphasizes the concept of "liberation theology," highlighting how the Church became a central force in advocating for human rights, providing sanctuary for the oppressed, and offering a voice for those caught in the middle of the conflict. The narrative centers on the intersection of faith and social justice, documenting the dangers faced by clergy and laypeople who challenged the military government at the time.

title: Hotel Stories
overview: A humble young man is called in for a night shift. But once he arrives, the place turns into a nightmare of strange guests, violent apparitions and impossible horrors, trapping him inside a haunted hotel where no one truly leaves.
tagline: THE HOTEL WAS HIRING. THE DEAD WERE WAITING.

title: Sandiwara Biola Ayah
overview: Azli's late wife wanted both of them to be involved in the field of arts. Their children, Asmadi is skilled at playing the violin and Asrul is proficient at playing the guitar, while Azli is good at singing. Asmadi feels ashamed of Azli's career as a Security Guard and is determined to leave home to seek his own pleasures. Azli sacrifices by providing for Asmadi's needs to become a renowned violin player. After succeeding, Asmadi becomes arrogant.

title: The Time Between
overview: A motor-racing film charting the life of four drivers during the twelve days between the finish of the French Grand Prix and British Grand Prix in 1964.

title: I Love You Mr Clown
overview: The story follows Fariz (Nabil Aqil), who works part-time as a clown at a charity program entertaining shopping mall visitors to raise funds for a children's cancer association. Nisa (Yuna Rahim) is a girl who has completed her studies six months ago and is beginning to feel anxious as all the job interviews she has attended have failed to secure her permanent employment at any company. Nisa wants to be independent and find work outside her family's business but remains unsuccessful. Nisa's anxiety worsens when her phobia of clowns becomes more severe. It has disrupted her sleep after being chased by a clown at a shopping mall. Moreover, Nisa's father has an enemy who seeks to take revenge on him through Nisa. Although various incidents occur, there is a clown who is often at the scene of incidents to rescue Nisa. Who could this person be? Can Nisa and Fariz escape from the incidents that haunt them?

title: Rajuk Rokiah
overview: It tells the story of Rokiah who is stressed with her husband's egocentric behavior and his reluctance to pay attention to her. Rokiah sulks and makes the decision to stay at her son's house. During Rokiah's absence, her husband finally feels the loss and misses Rokiah. To persuade Rokiah to come home, her husband has planned something special for Rokiah.

title: A Boy and his Flesh
overview: A young boy goes through bad habits as he faces something he’s never faced before.
tagline: To be free, something must die

title: Cyber 999
overview: Episode 1: Featuring the issue of Cyber Extortion Through Social Media Acquaintances. Episode 2: Featuring the issue of Social Media Profile Forgery

title: Sludge
overview: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

title: Totos, memoria de un pueblo olvidado
original_title: Totos, memoria de un pueblo olvidado
overview: Ayacucho, 1983. The government of Fernando Belaúnde Terry has just declared a state of emergency to combat the "people's war" launched by Shining Path. As a counterinsurgency strategy, the Army is establishing bases throughout the department. One of these first bases will be Totos. From that moment on, the Totos base will become a clandestine center for the detention, torture, and extrajudicial execution of suspected members of Shining Path.

title: Kami TV (Astro Citra)
overview: The life journey of 2 best friends since college days who are now founders of 'KamiTV' on a digital platform, transforms into a love triangle story after the appearance of a girl.

title: Hunger for Freedom
overview: In a dystopian future where cannibalism is legal, a woman will try to do whatever it takes to save his brother.
tagline: SURVIVAL HAS A NEW TASTE

title: El Expreso Cabanino
overview: 1984, the peak of violence in the armed conflict in Peru. The Communist Party – Shining Path tries to consolidate its control in the Ayacucho region. But the district of Soras resists. Comrade José devises a plan to crush the resistance in Soras. A plan beyond anyone's imagination.

title: Al Kisahnya Jenin
overview: It tells the story of Jenin, a person with great ambitions. Jenin dreams of opening a supermarket. He has met with Haji Shauki and told him about his ambition to open a supermarket. Haji Shauki promises to help on the condition that Jenin first sells the produce from his coconut plantation.

title: Nómadas sobre ruedas: 100 días en Mongolia
original_title: Nómadas sobre ruedas: 100 días en Mongolia
overview: A five-month journey will allow viewers to discover, through the eyes of the adventure's protagonists, the social and anthropological reality of this remote, and for many, unknown country: its political and religious context, the harsh reality faced by children in the capital and the NGOs working there to alleviate this problem; the simple, nature-driven life of the nomadic population, and the ancestral customs and traditions of the Kazakh people. All this and much more unfolds in a captivating journey filled with emotion, adventure, and humor.

title: Butterfly
overview: A nervous young poet takes the stage to perform, but as he speaks, his words are shown through a symbolic inner world where self-confinement takes physical form. He is asked to confront the cocoon he has built around himself, and fights to reach the world waiting for him beyond the silk. The poet must emerge from silence and self-doubt, completing metamorphosis, even with no one left as witness.
tagline: To become oneself in a world that asks you to stay small.

title: Cenduai (Awesome TV)
overview: This story is about the superstitious practice of using cenduai love oil which can make the face of the person who uses it become beautiful. Chalit was born with physical and facial deformities. The disability is believed to stem from a curse on his mother's lineage that has lasted for centuries. Midwife Esah is threatened to keep this condition secret.

title: Tamsyn Kelly: Hot Titty Bungalow
overview: Tamsyn Kelly brings sharp wit and wonderfully awkward storytelling to the stage in this hilarious stand-up performance about big life choices, messy relationships, and starting over in a new city. After impulsively moving from Cornwall to Glasgow for love, she quickly discovers that major decisions don’t always come with major planning.  Blending self-deprecating humor with clever observations, Tamsyn dives into long-distance dating, family dynamics, modern friendships, and the strange realities of adapting to a completely different culture. From awkward encounters with exes to bizarre local experiences and questionable attempts at self-discovery, every story is packed with relatable chaos and unexpected punchlines.  Warm, quirky, and brutally honest, this set showcases Tamsyn Kelly’s unique comedic voice as she turns life’s uncertainties into laugh-out-loud comedy.

title: Bébé fume
overview: Bébé and his sister try their first cigarettes, and it goes wrong.

title: Sinopsis Coast Guard Malaysia: Ops Helang
original_title: Sinopsis Coast Guard Malaysia: Ops Helang
overview: # Story of a Maritime Officer's Fight Against Crime  The story follows the life of Maritime Lieutenant Hafiz (Saharul Ridzwan), an officer of the Special Action and Rescue Team (STAR Team) of the Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (APMM), who wants to start a new life on an island after experiencing Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) due to the loss of his colleague during an operation. Hafiz also brings his fiancée Nurul to live with him after they decide to marry. However, during Hafiz and Nurul's engagement reception, an unknown group of criminals attacks them and kidnaps Hafiz, Nurul, their parents, and several other guests including some APMM members to hold them for ransom. Maritime Lieutenant Melati (Julia Farhana), an APMM Investigative Officer from the Maritime Crime Investigation Division tasked with investigating the case, manages to find and rescue Hafiz, Nurul, and his father.

title: Gunnera
overview: Shot on a single summer night in a Norfolk garden, 'Gunnera' is a self-indulgent and self-consciously camp little number. About that time, you could buy in the newsagents a rather handsomely photographed, glossy, fortnightly, soft porn magazine in full colour called 'Zeta'. Each number recounted the unlikely misadventures of scantily clad models threatened with fates worse than death. One of our two 'Gunnera' girls featured quite often in 'Zeta'. And that was where the concept (!) for the film came from. The sound track, of course, is from Pink Floyd's 'Umma Gumma'. As Frank Zappa might have said: 'Flora! Fauna! You wanna?...'

title: Syd's 24th Birthday
overview: Boxing Day, Cause and Control and Dad Bods perform live at WSUM studios in Madison, Wisconsin to celebrate the station's 24th Birthday on the eve of them being named the Best College Station in the Nation by Intercollegiate Broadcasting System
tagline: Happy Birthday to the Snake on the Lake!!!

title: ​​​Wayquis
overview: Yon and Dany run in terror through one of the vast wheat fields found in the Vilcanota mountain range. They head toward the only visible refuge: an abandoned cabin. Yon, who is in front and has a leg injury, forces the door open, while Dany, following behind, trips and falls to the ground. Yon manages to open the door, and Dany runs for her life. She narrowly avoids being trapped and enters the house. Yon and Dany desperately try to prevent the door from falling. The attack is ferocious. Dany is terrified, and Yon can only murmur a few prayers. Suddenly, the attack stops. There is a figure painted on the wall: a fox carrying a reptile in its mouth. Yon and Dany have a moment of respite, allowing them to consider their options. Dany has lost her cell phone while running, and in the middle of a tense argument between them, it rings from outside the house. Their only hope of rescue lies outside. Yon can't walk, and after some arguing, he manages to convince Dany to take the phone.

title: Infiltrate Proxy
overview: Infiltrate Proxy

title: Suzanne Wo Ai Ni
overview: Faris has saved Suzanne from an accident. Suzanne's brother, Alex, suspects that Faris is the cause of the accident that resulted in the death of Apple, his girlfriend. Alex tries to seek revenge against Faris in various ways, unaware that their father is a close friend.

title: Fight for the Fantasy
overview: A divorcée goes on her first date in years and immediately tries to force a love connection over chicken wings.

title: Friends Call Us Unlucky
overview: When Lucky and Dex, two naive and ill-equipped criminals, bungle a home invasion attempt, the homeowners early return sets off a series of events showcasing luck has nothing to do with it.

title: Serpihan Sayang

title: The Beauty and the Beast
overview: The Beauty and the Beast was filmed inside the Museo Civico di Storia Naturale in Milan.  The museum is empty, except for a little girl who, with an old satchel on her back, walks through it, crossing the gazes of taxidermied animals inside the display cases.  The girl’s innocence contrasts with the text she reads—almost as if voicing her thoughts—while the camera follows her from behind. What we hear is an altered excerpt from The Banality of Evil by German philosopher Hannah Arendt.  As she reads, the child seems to pose profound questions to the viewer about life, death, and human violence.  The name of Adolf Eichmann, the Nazi official prosecuted in the historic Jerusalem trial for crimes against humanity, has been removed from the text so that the girl never says his name—instead referring to him only as He or It.  This decision stems from the desire not to focus on a single historical episode, but to address the concept of the banality of evil in a broader, universal sense.

title: Kau Cipta Kasih
overview: The story tells of Samad (Sahronizam) and Sabariah (Sherie Merlis) who are united against the pressure of their families. This forced marriage has damaged Sabariah's relationship with Samad. Sabariah hates her children because she does not love Samad, who often mistreats her. Idris (Nafiz Muaz) is born with a disability in his legs. He is hated and not acknowledged as a child by Samad and Sabariah. He is raised by Opah Piah and Atuk Mat after being abandoned by his own parents. Despite his limp, Idris is taught to be self-reliant and to work since childhood. He is a hardworking person, devoted to religion and respectful towards his parents. Opah Piah has given him farmland and an ancestral homestead. Ramlah (Fify Azmi) is a very intelligent person who has the opportunity to continue her studies abroad with Idris's help. She deeply loves Khadijah, the eldest of these four siblings who has cared for her since childhood.
